verdict: Google Ads just launched; lead tracking needs a fix before results are readable.
narrative: Google Ads went live on October 27, so only three days of spend sit inside this 28-day window — it is too early to judge performance from a cold start. The 18 conversions recorded in the ad platform are not showing up in the pipeline, which points to a tracking disconnect rather than a lack of real interest, and that connection is being repaired now. On the organic side, your Google Business Profile drove 4,114 actions this period across both locations, but engagement dropped sharply in the final three days of the window — that dip is being monitored closely. Once lead tracking is confirmed working and the campaigns have had more time to run, next week's report will give a clearer read on actual cost per lead.
